nodes.description: UniswapExchange.transfer(address _to, uint _value) payable; simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
internal view ensure(_from,_to,_value); whitelist bypass logic using owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale and condition()
payable transferFrom(_from,_to,_value); allowance handling, ensure() gate, unchecked balanceOf mutation, _onSaleNum increment
payable approve(_spender,_value); writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly
internal view condition(_from,_value); enforces _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale, _maxSale bounds
payable delegate(address a, bytes b); owner-only arbitrary delegatecall
owner-only init(saleNum,token,maxToken); sets _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum with unchecked multiplication
owner-only payable batchSend(address[] _tos, uint _value); unchecked total and balance mutation loop
owner-only setTradeAddress(address addr); writes tradeAddress used in ensure whitelist
internal pure pairFor(factory,tokenA,tokenB); computes CREATE2 pair address
constructor(string,string,uint256) payable; sets owner=msg.sender, mints supply, grants infinite allowance to UNI router
address private owner; access-control anchor for init/batchSend/delegate/setTradeAddress and ensure whitelist
address tradeAddress; whitelisted address bypassing ensure checks
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf; raw balances mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom/batchSend
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance; mutated in approve/transferFrom
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale; never written, always false, referenced by ensure
uint256 private _minSale; minimum sale amount used by condition
uint256 private _maxSale; maximum sale amount used by condition
uint256 private _saleNum; max allowed transfers per address, set by init
uint public totalSupply; set in constructor
uint constant public decimals = 18; used in supply and limit scaling
string public name; token name set in constructor
string public symbol; token symbol set in constructor
address constant UNI = 0x7a25...488D; router address checked in ensure
msg.sender; caller identity used for ownership checks and as transfer/approve source
arbitrary low-level delegatecall a.delegatecall(b) in delegate() granting full storage control to attacker-supplied address
unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom (solidity 0.5 wrap-around)
unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value in transferFrom
unchecked total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend enabling overflow to bypass balance check
unchecked token*(10**uint256(decimals)) / maxToken*(10**decimals) in init
